presence_rationale: Substantive 'Preventing scams and fraud' section with named technologies and partnerships. Safety by design product development approach. Child Safeguarding Position Statement (a first for Westpac).
specificity_rationale: Names dynamic CVC (24-hr changing Card Verification Code), scam blocks (auto-blocking suspect overseas retailer transactions), gambling block, real-time security prompts (untrusted Wi-Fi detection), abusive message blocking, fraud teams 24/7. IDCARE partnership for regional/rural Australians (50 new hubs). Scam specialists +50%. Westpac became first private Australian business to block scammer-impersonation calls.
quantification_rationale: Reports 80% reduction in average customer credit-card fraud since dynamic CVC introduction, 42,000+ customers assisted by specialist customer-care teams, 61,000+ gambling blocks applied to credit/debit cards, 2,300+ warning letters sent, 48,000+ transactions blocked in real time containing abusive messages. Australians lost $2bn+ to scams in 2021. SASB FN-CB-230a.1 metric (number of breaches, % personal data, customers affected) not directly disclosed in retrieved chunks.
